summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of new Psychological Deep Dive product. All 10 unit tests (tests/test_psych_deep.py) pass. Wrote 11-test E2E suite (tests/test_psych_deep_api.py) hitting live /api/psych-deep endpoints — 100% pass, covering schema, persistence, scoring, gates, report generate, PDF, guest-403, and DELETE cleanup. All 77 regression tests (edu_deep, snc2, snc2_api, snc2_comparison, snc2_compare_api, snc2_enhancements) remain green. Frontend UI verified: psych-deep-root loads, 11 progress dots present (s4/s6 hidden by default; s4 dot appears after has_medication=Yes), psych-deep-report-root + download button render, both CTA cards render on /special-needs-v2 picker view, and all three toolbar links appear on the assessment view. Test data cleaned up via DELETE /api/psych-deep/me.

minor.issue: fpdf DeprecationWarnings (ln=1, dest='S') — non-blocking but should migrate to XPos/YPos API.

critical_code_review_comments: psych_deep_routes.py is clean: excludes MongoDB _id via projections; enforces validate_answer on both single and bulk; correctly returns 403 for guests on /report/generate; DELETE /me wipes both assessments and reports collections.

Gate logic is correctly implemented on both backend (score_deep_dive sets is_visible=False when gate answer is not 'Yes') and frontend (s4/s6 progress dots hidden until gate satisfied — verified live).
Minor: consider migrating fpdf calls from ln=1 to new_x/new_y kwargs to silence DeprecationWarnings when fpdf2 removes the ln param.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable data-testids present and gating works

seed_data_creation: Seeded a low-answer psych_deep assessment for parent1@test.com to exercise report/PDF flow, then DELETE /api/psych-deep/me was called to wipe both psych_deep_assessments and psych_deep_reports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_psych_deep_api.py is a reusable regression suite for the Psychological Deep Dive routes (schema, /answer, /answers/bulk, /me, /score, /report/generate, /report/pdf, /auth/guest → 403, DELETE /me). Use parent1@test.com / TestPass123!. UI: two CTA cards `snc2-edu-deep-dive-cta` and `snc2-psych-deep-dive-cta` only render on the pathway picker view (before selecting a pathway). Toolbar links snc2-open-edu-deep-dive / snc2-open-psych-deep-dive / snc2-open-compare only render on the assessment view (after selecting a pathway). The s4 and s6 progress dots (psych-deep-goto-s4, psych-deep-goto-s6) are intentionally hidden until s4_has_medication='Yes' / s6_attends_therapy='Yes' respectively — verified live.
